entries.en: to snatch; to carry off by force
entries.notes: 词头 arrebarar 当为 arrebatár（抢夺）之 17 世纪讹写，据汉字「強」与闽/官双音写互证定夺

entries.zh: 强逆；强行夺去（逆其意而强夺）
entries.en: to snatch by force; to take against (someone's) will
to rob; to seize (clothing, goods) by force

entries.zh: 强劫；强占他人财物而逃
entries.en: to rob by force; to make off with another's property
entries.notes: 第二字原件作「却」、标注[疑:劫]，据西语 alçarse con lo ajeno（强占他人之物）定为强劫义

entries.en: to strip away by force; to deprive forcibly
to seize by force; to occupy forcibly
entries.notes: 第二字标注[疑:亡]，然官话音写 chièn 合于「占」，从占解

entries.zh: 强夺；用力拽夺〔西语子目残讹，词义存疑〕
entries.en: to snatch away with force (Spanish sub-entry corrupt; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语子目 fuess/vtumpa 残讹不可解，首字[疑:棚]、次字「扐」罕用，仅据本页强夺词族与 sá-lia 音写推拟

entries.en: to snatch with the hand
entries.notes: 首字标注[疑:棚]未定，西语子目 con la mano 清楚，义为用手拉夺

entries.zh: 用手扯开去；拽开〔西语原文有残，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to pull apart with the hands (source text partly damaged; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: L 栏含[残]，据 M/R 音写「開去」与语境拟为用手扯开

entries.en: to carry off; to take away (snatched goods)
entries.notes: 首字标注[疑:椴]，音写 pūa 合于「搬」，西语子目含 llevar（携走），定为搬走义

entries.en: rosy sunset clouds (Sp. arreboles)
rosy clouds (Sp. arrebol)
color of the clouds
purple cloud
to invigorate the yang (male vigor)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Arrechar 残讹不可解，据汉字「興陽」与闽/官双音写定夺，取 17 世纪医学「提振阳气」义

entries.en: to hold; to take up; to assist
entries.notes: 西语子目（Arre çar çara / naxoçlaro）残讹不可解，「攝」与音写未尽吻合，据汉字栏取本义

entries.en: to take up; to roll up (sleeves)
entries.notes: 西语子目后半（legual qüara）残讹，据「攝起」音写与 arremangar（挽袖）义定夺

entries.zh: 拿捏女阴（向妇人撩裙动手，猥亵）
entries.en: to grope a woman's privates; to lift a woman's skirts
entries.notes: 首字标注[疑:扱]，西语 omger 当为 moger（妇人）之讹，据「陰」字与语境定为猥亵义

entries.en: to rent; to lease; to let for hire
to connect; to link; in succession
entries.notes: 西语词头与注文（Arrexo/venglera）残讹不可解，据汉字「連」与闽/官双音写定夺
